# 3) ACP 

```{r}
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(dplyr)

# Variables retenues pour l'ACP
data_acp <- OECD %>%
  select(
    logements_sans_equipements_pct,
    pieces_par_personne,
    revenu_disponible_menages,
    patrimoine_financier_menages,
    insecurite_marche_travail_pct,
    taux_emploi_pct,
    revenus_du_travail_usd,
    soutien_social_pct,
    niveau_education_pct,
    competences_eleves_score,
    annees_education,
    qualite_eau_pct,
    esperance_vie_ans,
    satisfaction_vie_score,
    sentiment_securite_nuit_pct
  )

# ACP sur variables centrées-réduites
acp <- PCA(
  data_acp,
  scale.unit = TRUE,
  graph = FALSE
)

# Cercle des corrélations
p_acp <- fviz_pca_var(
  acp,
  col.var = "cos2",
  repel = TRUE,
  labelsize = 3
) +
  labs(
    title = "ACP des conditions de vie dans les pays de l'OCDE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_acp

ggsave(
  "figures/acp_cercle_correlations.png",
  plot = p_acp,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```


# 4) PCR

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. PRÉPARATION DES DONNÉES ET SPLIT


# Sélection des variables (on garde la liste 'vars' présente dans acp)
vars <- c(
  "logements_sans_equipements_pct", "pieces_par_personne",
  "revenu_disponible_menages", "patrimoine_financier_menages",
  "insecurite_marche_travail_pct", "taux_emploi_pct",
  "revenus_du_travail_usd", "soutien_social_pct",
  "niveau_education_pct", "competences_eleves_score",
  "annees_education", "qualite_eau_pct",
  "esperance_vie_ans", "sentiment_securite_nuit_pct",
  "satisfaction_vie_score"
)

OECD_clean <- OECD[, vars]

# Création des échantillons Apprentissage (Train) et Test (Test)
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(OECD_clean$satisfaction_vie_score, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train <- OECD_clean[trainIndex, ]
test  <- OECD_clean[-trainIndex, ]

# Dimensions
n <- nrow(train)
p <- ncol(train) - 1
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 2. CONSTRUCTION DU MODÈLE PCR ET VALIDATION CROISÉE

model_pcr <- pcr(satisfaction_vie_score ~ ., 
                 data = train,
                 scale = TRUE,
                 validation = "CV")

# Nombre optimal de composantes
k_opt_pcr <- selectNcomp(model_pcr, method = "onesigma", plot = TRUE)

cat("Nombre de composantes retenu (PCR) :", k_opt_pcr)

# Graphiques CV
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(model_pcr, "validation", val.type = "R2", main = "R² (CV)")
plot(model_pcr, "validation", val.type = "RMSEP", main = "RMSEP (CV)")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 3. PERFORMANCE POUR CHAQUE NOMBRE DE COMPOSANTES


R2_test_all <- sapply(1:p, function(n) {
  pred <- predict(model_pcr, newdata = test, ncomp = n)
  1 - sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred)^2) /
      sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - mean(test$satisfaction_vie_score))^2)
})

RMSE_test_all <- sapply(1:p, function(n) {
  pred <- predict(model_pcr, newdata = test, ncomp = n)
  sqrt(mean((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred)^2))
})

# Tableau propre
perf_pcr <- data.frame(
  Composantes = 1:p,
  R2_test = round(R2_test_all, 3),
  RMSE_test = round(RMSE_test_all, 3)
)

perf_pcr
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 5. COMPARAISON AVEC MODÈLE LINÉAIRE

# Modele pcr 

pred_test_pcr <- predict(model_pcr, newdata = test, ncomp = k_opt_pcr)

R2_test_pcr <- 1 - sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_test_pcr)^2) /
                   sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - mean(test$satisfaction_vie_score))^2)

RMSE_test_pcr <- sqrt(mean((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_test_pcr)^2))

# Modele lm 

lm_model <- lm(satisfaction_vie_score ~ ., data = train)
pred_lm <- predict(lm_model, newdata = test)

R2_lm <- 1 - sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_lm)^2) /
             sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - mean(test$satisfaction_vie_score))^2)

RMSE_lm <- sqrt(mean((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_lm)^2))

# Tableau comparatif
comparaison <- data.frame(
  Modele = c("Régression Linéaire", "PCR"),
  Composantes = c(p, k_opt_pcr),
  R2_test = round(c(R2_lm, R2_test_pcr), 3),
  RMSE_test = round(c(RMSE_lm, RMSE_test_pcr), 3)
)

kable(comparaison, caption = "Comparaison des modèles") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```



```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 6. GRAPH DIAGNOSTIC

comparison_pcr <- data.frame(
  Reel = test$satisfaction_vie_score,
  Predit = as.vector(pred_test_pcr)
)

ggplot(comparison_pcr, aes(x = Reel, y = Predit)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "PCR : Valeurs réelles vs prédites",
       subtitle = paste("R² =", round(R2_test_pcr, 3)),
       x = "Valeurs réelles",
       y = "Valeurs prédites") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed()
```


```{r}
# 1. Fonction VIP 
get_vip <- function(model, ncomp) {
  b <- c(model$Yloadings)[1:ncomp]
  T <- model$scores[,1:ncomp, drop = FALSE]
  SS <- b^2 * colSums(T^2)
  W <- model$loading.weights[,1:ncomp, drop = FALSE]
  Wnorm2 <- colSums(W^2)
  VIP <- sqrt(nrow(W) * apply(sweep(W^2, 2, SS/Wnorm2, "*"), 1, sum) / sum(SS))
  return(VIP)
}
```

```{r}
# 2. Ajustement du modèle PLS (Entraînement avec LOO)
set.seed(123)
#validation = "LOO" (conseil de la prof)
model_pls <- plsr(satisfaction_vie_score ~ ., 
                  data = train, 
                  scale = TRUE, 
                  method = "oscorespls", 
                  validation = "LOO")
```

```{r}
# 3. SÉLECTION DU NOMBRE OPTIMAL DE COMPOSANTES

k_opt_pls <- selectNcomp(model_pls, method = "onesigma", plot = TRUE)

kable(data.frame(Composantes_retenues = k_opt_pls),
      caption = "Nombre optimal de composantes (PLS)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)


```



```{r}
# 4. ÉVOLUTION DES PERFORMANCES (TRAIN vs TEST)

max_comp <- p

perf_df <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:max_comp) {
  
    # Prediction Train
  pred_tr <- predict(model_pls, ncomp = i)
  rmse_tr <- sqrt(mean((train$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_tr)^2))
  
  # Prediction Test
  pred_te <- predict(model_pls, newdata = test, ncomp = i)
  rmse_te <- sqrt(mean((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_te)^2))
  
  perf_df <- rbind(perf_df,
                   data.frame(Comp = i, RMSE = rmse_tr, Type = "Train"),
                   data.frame(Comp = i, RMSE = rmse_te, Type = "Test"))
}

ggplot(perf_df, aes(x = Comp, y = RMSE, color = Type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = k_opt_pls, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Évolution du RMSE (Train vs Test)",
       x = "Nombre de composantes", y = "RMSE") +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
# 5. R² SUR TEST SELON LE NOMBRE DE COMPOSANTES

R2_test_pls_all <- sapply(1:max_comp, function(n) {
  pred <- predict(model_pls, newdata = test, ncomp = n)
  1 - sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred)^2) /
      sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - mean(test$satisfaction_vie_score))^2)
})

perf_pls <- data.frame(
  Composantes = 1:max_comp,
  R2_test = round(R2_test_pls_all, 3)
)

kable(perf_pls, caption = "R² sur test selon le nombre de composantes") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# 6. PERFORMANCE GLOBALE (TRAIN ET TEST)

pred_train_pls <- predict(model_pls, ncomp = k_opt_pls)
pred_test_pls  <- predict(model_pls, newdata = test, ncomp = k_opt_pls)

R2_train_pls <- 1 - sum((train$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_train_pls)^2) /
  sum((train$satisfaction_vie_score - mean(train$satisfaction_vie_score))^2)

R2_test_pls <- 1 - sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_test_pls)^2) /
  sum((test$satisfaction_vie_score - mean(test$satisfaction_vie_score))^2)

RMSE_test_pls <- sqrt(mean((test$satisfaction_vie_score - pred_test_pls)^2))

result_pls <- data.frame(
  Modele = "PLS",
  Composantes = k_opt_pls,
  R2_train = round(R2_train_pls, 3),
  R2_test = round(R2_test_pls, 3),
  RMSE_test = round(RMSE_test_pls, 3)
)

kable(result_pls, caption = "Performance globale du modèle PLS") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# 7. IMPORTANCE DES VARIABLES (VIP ET COEFFICIENTS)

vips_valeurs <- get_vip(model_pls, k_opt_pls)
coeffs_valeurs <- as.numeric(coef(model_pls, ncomp = k_opt_pls))

df_importance <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(vips_valeurs),
  VIP = as.numeric(vips_valeurs),
  Coefficient = coeffs_valeurs
)

# VIP
p_vip <- ggplot(df_importance, aes(x = reorder(Variable, VIP), y = VIP)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = ifelse(df_importance$VIP > 1, "firebrick", "steelblue")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Importance des variables (VIP)",
       x = "Variables", y = "VIP") +
  theme_minimal()

p_vip

ggsave(
  "figures/importance_variables_pls.png",
  plot = p_vip,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Coefficients
ggplot(df_importance, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Coefficient), y = Coefficient)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = ifelse(df_importance$Coefficient > 0, "darkgreen", "darkred")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Effet des variables (coefficients PLS)",
       x = "Variables", y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal()
```
